source_text: Si iuraverit quis ut male faciat vel bene et absconderit, deliquit. Verbum temerarium vinculum fit. Sit sermo vester est est, non non.
pass_a_gloss: If will-have-sworn someone that badly he-may-do or well and will-have-hidden, he-has-failed. Word rash bond becomes. Let-it-be speech your yes yes, no no.
pass_b_english: If someone swears rashly to do evil or good and hides it, he has failed [[Leviticus 5:4 >> Bible:Leviticus 5:4]]. A reckless word becomes a bond. Let your speech be [[Yes, yes; No, no >> Bible:Matthew 5:37]].
